headline: SAFF holds at 4.32 on Female Daily with the most reviews tracked, but ranks only 4th on Shopee share (3.53%) behind Mykonos and HMNS; longevity and fakes stay the key risks.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: SAFF's Female Daily rating is flat at 4.32 on 1,746 reviews (most of any brand); Alchemist leads at 4.43. Mykonos slipped 4.27 to 4.26 as Moroccan Vanilla fell from 4.4 to 4.2.
On Shopee, SAFF holds 3.53% perfume market share in Q2 2026, 4th behind Mykonos (6.78%), Scarlett and HMNS (5.09%): high review quality is not yet top volume.
S.O.T.B still holds a third of SAFF's reviews at 4.1; recent reviews praise 6–8 hour wear, but one calls it heady and 'too common now'.
Longevity is mixed by scent: Troupe has 95% recommend, yet some reviewers get only 4–5 hours on skin and say the 'Extrait' label over-promises; Cascavel's recommend rate is lowest seen (86%).

Social buzz is creator-led: a TikTok review calls Eulalie soft and addictive, while a Threads 'honest review' asks if a SAFF best-seller is just hype. Instagram search found no new public posts today.

recommendations.text: Dig into S.O.T.B and Loui low-star reviews to see if 'too strong / headache' is a pattern, then add wear guidance (spray count, day vs night) to product pages; upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder to enable this.
Set clear longevity expectations per scent (e.g. hours on skin vs fabric) so the 'Extrait' label does not over-promise; start with Troupe and Cascavel.
Close the Shopee gap with Mykonos and HMNS: push top-rated scents (Xocolatl, Irai Leima, Troupe) with review highlights and creator content on Shopee and Instagram.
Add a travel or slim bottle and review Eulalie's bottle design; ask QC to check leaks and outer-box damage in shipping.
Run a short quarterly survey (awareness, consideration, NPS) and add an official 'how to spot a fake' guide on SAFF channels, including for Japan buyers.
